visual_logic: Highlights the radical, bristle-like, ultra-fine filtering comb teeth of the Pterodaustro lower jaw.
prompt: High-fidelity 3D asset of a section of the lower jaw from a Pterodaustro, showcase-focused on its radical 'Baleen Comb' teeth, rendered in a 3D animated feature film aesthetic with soft, stylized edges. The jaw segment is packed with hundreds of ultra-fine, needle-thin, flexible pinkish-ivory bristles standing tightly packed together like a dense grooming comb. The texture is organic, flexible, and finely detailed. The specimen is oriented diagonally and perfectly centered in a 1:1 square composition, carefully scaled to occupy the central power-zone, ensuring a strict 25% negative space safety margin on all four sides. Placed flat against a neutral, 50% grey studio floor plane with high-contrast contact shadows. Illuminated by soft studio lighting with ambient occlusion to emphasize the fine, individual bristle details.
